newsitem.title: RUSSIA: PRESS DIGEST - IZVESTIA - RUSSIA - MAY 22.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - IZVESTIA - RUSSIA - MAY 22.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the May 23 edition of Russia's Izvestia newspaper. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The government signs guarantees for a big credit to an ailing Russian company several weeks after swearing to put an end to such budget-wrecking practices.
- Foreign entrepreneurs working in Russia rate the country's competitiveness higher than official statistics.
- The first auction to sell off flashy foreign cars previously used by state officials will take place on June 20.
- The Russian pharmaceuticals industry is fighting to stay afloat amid an onslaught by foreign producers.
